_doc: B-render: heart poses at play distance (owner bar: noticed without clicking at 40-80 m): mixed signs (fear/fist/cheer/pray by id) at 40/70 m, each sign alone at 60 m, mixed at 60 m on low/high/ultra. Lookdev village, stub signs.

shots.name: b0b-pose-fear-60
script: document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); G.ui_.closeAll(); const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = false; if (!window.__p) window.__p = G.poi('village'); const p = window.__p;
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 60, tilt: 58, yaw: p.heading, fov: 50, hour: 10 }); await G.frames(8); F.advance(1); await G.frames(3);

const A = F.fx.vis.pv.agents; const m = {}; for (let k = 0; k < A.count; k++) m[String(A.id[k])] = [3, 2, 4, 1][A.id[k] % 4]; G.arc.stub('hearts', { signs: m });
